language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Changes the language of the app. The project language — the one Kato asks and judges in — is set separately on the practice page.

metadata.defaultDescription: Rehearse against the rubric, then defend the evidence behind your claims.
metadata.socialDescription: Rehearse against the real rubric, inspect exact evidence, and practise the hardest grounded question.
metadata.enterDescription: Name this workspace and start rehearsing against a real evaluation rubric.
metadata.savedDescription: Review a saved rehearsal against its delivery observations and rubric evidence.

entryGate.title: Put your name on this workspace.
entryGate.intro: Start immediately without creating an account. Your display name and guest rehearsal history stay in this browser unless you deliberately use the synced account option.
entryGate.nameRequired: Type the name you want on this workspace.
entryGate.syncTitle: Need your projects on another device?
entryGate.syncBody: The account page uses the configured authentication service for optional sync.
entryGate.asideQuote: “Bring the rubric you will actually be judged against.”

landing.lede: No score. No speaking-ability rating. Just your own sentences, mapped to the rubric you will be marked against.
landing.demoQuote: “Unlike generic delivery coaches, Talk-Active starts from the evaluator rubric.”
landing.demoCitation: Exact words from the rehearsal transcript
landing.demoGap: Name the closest alternative and the mechanism it lacks.
landing.demoQuestion: What makes this different from putting the same rubric into a general chat tool?
landing.useCasesTitle: One method, plenty of rooms that decide things.
landing.useCase1Body: Connect your product claims to the scoring rubric before the Q&A.
landing.useCase2Body: Make each selection criterion obvious in the answer you rehearse.
landing.useCase3Body: Find where a method or conclusion still wobbles.
landing.useCase4Body: Any room where a written rubric decides the outcome.
landing.footerTagline: Rubric-grounded rehearsal for answers that need evidence.
landing.loopTitle: Four steps, one piece of evidence.
landing.loopStep1Body: One place for one talk you are preparing.
landing.loopStep2Body: The real one you will be marked against, not a generic example.
landing.loopStep3Body: Type it or say it. Camera and microphone stay off until you turn them on.
landing.loopStep4Body: Your own sentences mapped to each criterion — and what is still missing.

account.title: Practise first. Sync only when it helps.
account.lede: An account is for continuity across devices. It never gates a first rehearsal.
account.guestTitle: Account sync is not configured here.
account.guestBody: Your local workspace remains fully usable. When the deployment has Postgres and an auth secret, this same screen enables account creation and sign-in.
account.passwordNote: Use 10–128 characters. Passwords are handled by Better Auth; Talk-Active does not place them in project or transcript records.
account.importLegacy: Bring in {count, plural, one {# browser project} other {# browser projects}}
account.deleteInstruction: Type {phrase} to remove the account, sessions, projects, and synced transcripts by database cascade. Local browser data is separate.
account.guide1Body: No account is required for a first run.
account.guide2Body: Account records live in the configured Postgres deployment, not inside transcripts.
account.guide3Body: Signing in does not change where configured model providers process criterion-scoped text.
account.boundaryBody: A camera-and-microphone replay is saved only after you opt in. Durable replay requires a signed-in owner and private storage; deleting it keeps the text feedback. Local work is separate.
account.statusCreated: Account created. This browser can now sync work when persistence is enabled.
account.statusRequestFailed: The account request could not be completed.
account.statusSignedOut: Signed out. Local guest mode remains available.
account.statusExported: Local browser data exported. Nothing was deleted.
account.statusImported: {projects} projects and {sessions} session summaries imported. The original browser data is still here.
account.statusImportFailed: The local workspace could not be imported.
account.statusDeleted: Synced account data was permanently deleted. Local browser data was left untouched.
account.statusDeleteFailed: The account data could not be deleted.

progressCharts.trendEmpty: Save a practice session to begin the evidence trend.

fillers.label: Filler frequency
fillers.measured: {count} configured filler events found in the transcript.

pauseRatio.label: Pause ratio
pauseRatio.absent: Audio pause observations were not supplied.

pitchVariation.label: Pitch variation
pitchVariation.measured: Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean pitch for voiced samples.
pitchVariation.absent: At least five voiced pitch samples are required.

energyVariation.label: Energy variation
energyVariation.measured: Calculated as standard deviation divided by mean RMS energy for non-silent samples.
energyVariation.absent: At least five non-silent energy samples are required.

trackingCoverage.label: Tracking coverage
trackingCoverage.measured: {tracked} of {sampled} sampled frames contained usable landmarks.

framingCoverage.label: Framing coverage
framingCoverage.measured: {framed} of {tracked} tracked frames met the mode framing rule. The framing rule changed on 17 August 2026: half body now counts as framed, so visual scores from before then are not comparable.
framingCoverage.absent: Usable landmarks are required before framing can be measured. The framing rule changed on 17 August 2026: half body now counts as framed, so visual scores from before then are not comparable.

movementActivity.label: Movement activity
movementActivity.measured: {active} tracked frames crossed the calibrated movement threshold.
movementActivity.absent: Usable landmarks are required before movement can be measured.

deliveryMetrics.compositionLabel: Composition of the {total} out of 100 reading: {summary}.
deliveryMetrics.averageLegend: The dashed line marks {total}, where these blocks average out.

micQuality.silentBody: No signal at all. Check whether it is muted, or whether another device is selected.
micQuality.clippingTitle: This microphone is too loud and distorting
micQuality.clippingBody: The level is pinned, so words run together. Move back a little or turn the device gain down.
micQuality.noisyFloorBody: Something is audible between every phrase — usually a mic being held, vibrating, or resting on a desk. The recognizer has no silence to break sentences on. Try a stable surface, or the laptop microphone.
micQuality.tooQuietTitle: This is too faint to recognise
micQuality.tooQuietBody: There is sound, but very little of it. Move closer or turn the device gain up.
micQuality.boundary: This reads levels from our recording stream, not from the recognizer — echo and room reverb are not detected here.
micQuality.typedFallback: You can always type the transcript instead.
micQuality.guessedTitle: Some of this transcript was guessed
micQuality.guessedBody: The recognizer was unsure about {count, plural, one {# passage} other {# passages}}. Check and correct them before reviewing — a misheard passage gets quoted back as your own words.

It does not retain the component bands needed to defend an aggregate delivery reading, so no vocal, visual, or overall score is shown. interviewSession.heading: Answer one rubric question at a time.
interviewSession.answerPlaceholder: Start with a direct answer, then give the evidence and why it matters…
interviewSession.waitPlaceholder: Begin this answer after Kato finishes speaking…
interviewSession.startOrType: Start optional capture below, or type without media.
interviewSession.captureRequired: Continuous capture must start before the first answer
interviewSession.captureBoundary: Camera and an optional replay share one timeline. Dictation and acoustic observations run only inside answer windows, never while Kato narrates.
interviewSession.pausedBoundary: Camera and the optional replay remain active between questions. Answer text and voice observations are paused while Kato speaks.
interviewSession.modelBoundary: No model request runs between questions. Final submit sends each answer only with its paired rubric criterion; Kato's question text is excluded. Separated turn transcripts and an optional replay remain page-local in this experimental flow; saved progress keeps the aggregate rubric summary.

interviewSession.pauseFirst: Pause the current answer before asking Kato to read the question.

interviewSession.reviewFailed: The final interview review could not be completed.
interviewSession.reviewIncomplete: The final interview review did not map every answer back to its rubric criterion.
interviewSession.noCriterionEvidence: The deterministic interview review returned no criterion evidence.
interviewSession.answersSavedLocally: Each answer is saved locally and the next question appears immediately. One final submit reviews all {count} answers without mixing their evidence.
interviewSession.cappedAtFixedQuestions: The interview is capped at {max} fixed questions.

multimodalReview.compositionBody: The bar is the complete arithmetic: each block is as wide as the share it carried and as full as it scored. Unmeasured signals are excluded from the mean rather than counted as zero.
multimodalReview.experimentalCandidates: Audio and interim-dictation events are experimental candidates, not diagnoses; emphasis, held vowels, noise suppression, microphone gating, or ordinary phrasing can produce similar patterns. They do not change the vocal or rubric reading.

practice.evidenceMappedByDeterministicCue: Evidence mapped by deterministic cue matching on this device.
practice.everyRubricCriterionAndWhether: Every rubric criterion and whether this attempt cites a transcript span for it
practice.breakThisDownCriterionBy: Break this down criterion by criterion
practice.breakThisDownAnswerBy: Break this down answer by answer
practice.everyCriterionGetsItsOwn: Every criterion gets its own reading: what you asserted for it, which of those assertions you backed with your own words, and a stronger form built only from what you already said.
practice.everyAnswerGetsItsOwn: Every answer gets its own reading: what you asserted for its criterion, which of those assertions you backed with your own words, and a stronger form built only from what you already said. Each answer is read on its own, so Kato’s wording never counts as your evidence.
practice.claimCoachingIsUnavailableRight: Claim coaching is unavailable right now. The rubric verdicts above are unaffected.
practice.coachingForThisAnswerWas: Coaching for this answer was unavailable. Its verdict above is unaffected.
practice.yourYesOrNoOn: Your Yes or No on a criterion is recorded once as your own evaluation label, and cannot be changed afterwards.
practice.theSemanticReviewFoundNo: The semantic review found no exact passage that supplies this criterion's required evidence.
practice.nothingInThisAttemptMatched: Nothing in this attempt matched the declared cues for this criterion.
practice.oneQuoteIsDoingMore: One quote is doing more than one job.
practice.nothingInThisAttemptBacks: Nothing in this attempt backs it.
practice.thisAttemptAssertsNothingAbout: This attempt asserts nothing about this criterion — there is no claim to back or challenge yet.
practice.aStrongerFormOfThis: A stronger form of this answer
practice.eachBlankIsDataThis: Each blank is data this attempt never stated. Fill it with a number you have — or say the measurement has not been done, which is also an answer.
practice.rearrangedFromYourOwnWords: Rearranged from your own words only. A number absent from your transcript is rejected before this is shown.
practice.thisCheckUsesOnlyThe: This check uses only the answer above, never the original pitch.
practice.answerDirectlyNameTheMechanism: Answer directly. Name the mechanism, comparison, or proof the rubric expects.
practice.sayItInYourOwn: Say it in your own words.
practice.checkedByDeterministicCueMatching: Checked by deterministic cue matching because semantic defense evaluation is not configured.
practice.hostedDefenseEvaluationWasUnavailable: Hosted defense evaluation was unavailable. This visible deterministic fallback was not synced.
practice.mappedSemanticallyAgainstThisAnswer: Mapped semantically against this answer, then grounded to the exact cited span.
practice.sessionHistoryStaysInThis: Session history stays in this browser
practice.reviewAnAttemptBeforeEntering: Review an attempt before entering the judge room.
practice.everyVerdictBelowUsedOnly: Every verdict below used only its paired answer. Kato's wording was excluded from evidence.
practice.oneFinalBatchProducedThese: One final batch produced these answer-local verdicts. Question text is shown for context but was never sent as answer evidence.
practice.oneContinuousInterviewCaptureIs: One continuous interview capture is attached to this page-local review.
practice.noCameraOrMicrophoneCapture: No camera or microphone capture was attached to this interview.
practice.wordsThatInviteTheNext: Words that invite the next question

practice.wordPatternCountsFromThis: Word-pattern counts from this transcript, and not a measure of speaking ability. This does not change the rubric evidence above.
practice.retakeAdditionTooLong: This addition would take the transcript past the {limit}-character limit. Shorten the transcript or this addition before re-judging.
practice.retakeWeakestQuestionRefreshed: Because the weakest criterion changed after re-judging, its judge question and focused drill were rebuilt with deterministic cue matching.
practice.retakeQuestionRefreshed: The re-judged criterion question used {engine} generation; its focused drill was rebuilt deterministically.
practice.captureOnlyTheMissingPassage: Capture only the missing passage. It will be labelled as an addition and re-judge this criterion alone.
practice.sayOrTypeOnlyThe: Say or type only the passage that proves this criterion. It is appended to the attempt and labelled as an addition — the original take is never rewritten — and only this criterion is judged again.
practice.nameTheNumberMethodOr: Name the number, method, or mechanism this criterion asks for.
practice.typeTheAdditionBelowOr: Type the addition below, or switch to

practice.thatCriterionIsNoLonger: That criterion is no longer part of this review.

practice.savedInThisBrowserThis: Saved in this browser. This criterion was re-checked once with the rejected sentence excluded.
practice.savedInThisBrowserA: Saved in this browser. A one-time semantic re-judge used different grounded evidence and refreshed the question.
practice.savedInThisBrowserThe: Saved in this browser. The hosted re-judge was unavailable, so one visible deterministic fallback ran locally.
practice.savedInThisBrowserThe2: Saved in this browser. The one-time re-judge used mixed semantic and deterministic units, shown in provenance.
practice.savedThisCriterionWasRe: Saved. This criterion was re-judged once without the rejected evidence.

practice.savedWithSemanticEvidenceMapping: Saved with semantic evidence mapping. The cited text comes only from this answer.
practice.savedWithALabelledDeterministic: Saved with a labelled deterministic fallback. Only this answer was evaluated.
practice.thisEvaluationLabelCouldNot: This evaluation label could not be saved.
practice.aPersistedVerdictDidNot: A persisted verdict did not map to its confirmed criterion.
practice.thePersistedReviewContainedNo: The persisted review contained no criteria.

practice.derivedSensorSummariesAreAvailable: Derived sensor summaries are available for this review only.
practice.derivedFromOnDeviceCamera: Derived from on-device camera landmarks; review the surrounding replay before interpreting it.
practice.timestampedDeliveryObservationsWereSaved: Timestamped delivery observations were saved with this attempt. No replay was recorded.
practice.timestampedObservationsWereSavedThis: Timestamped observations were saved. This replay stays in this page only; download it before leaving.
practice.privateReplaySavedItIs: Private replay saved. It is now available from attempt history and can be deleted without deleting feedback.
practice.uploadingThePrivateReplayKeep: Uploading the private replay… Keep this review open until it finishes.
practice.theTranscriptChangedSoThe: The transcript changed, so the prior sensor summary was detached. Capture again to include fresh observations.
practice.projectSyncIsActiveOn: Project sync is active on this deployment
practice.thisProjectHasNoConfirmed: This project has no confirmed rubric yet. Confirm its rubric before starting a rehearsal.
practice.confirmThisProjectSRubric: Confirm this project’s rubric before saving an attempt to it.

practice.thatSelectedProjectCouldNot: That selected project could not be opened. Choose another project; no saved project data was changed.
practice.yourSavedProjectCouldNot: Your saved project could not be restored just now, so this attempt uses the rubric stored in this browser. Nothing saved on the server has been changed.

practice.languageCueCount: {count, plural, one {# language cue} other {# language cues}}

practice.sourceRemoved: {filename} was permanently removed from private storage.
